newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European Commission's Brittan pays tribute to Deng.
newsitem.headline: European Commission's Brittan pays tribute to Deng.

text.p: Sir Leon Brittan, European Commissioner with responsibility for relations with Asia, said on Wednesday he expected China to continue along the path of modernisation set out by paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, whose death was announced earlier.

"Deng played a remarkable and courageous role as leader, putting China on the path of modernisation. I am sure the leadership he provided will continue for many years to help China to add still further to the outstanding achievements of recent years," said Brittan, contacted by telephone by Reuters.
European Commission President Jacques Santer was not immediately available for comment.
